subject: Scaling request ahead of renewal — additional on‑prem cluster & isolation
messages:
From: Lucas Perez <lucas.perez@arcadiadiagnostics.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Scaling request ahead of renewal — additional on‑prem cluster & isolation

Evelyn,

We're coming up on our renewal for our private/on‑prem footprint (Feb 15 renewal window) and need to lock in capacity and isolation changes now. High level: we need an additional on‑prem cluster in our Atlanta region (to host analytics workload), and stricter tenant isolation for the analytics environment — PHI scope.

Key asks:
- Ballpark pricing for: one additional on‑prem cluster (same spec as current), + isolation (separate ingest/compute nodes).
- Proposed lead time and any procurement/PO gating points.
- Whether a term extension (12 -> 24 months) would reduce unit cost and if there's a renewal credit for early commitment.

Attached is our updated capacity plan (MAP_v2.xlsx) with expected token throughput. Can we schedule a 30m call this week to run through options?

Thanks,
Lucas Perez
Head of Platform Engineering
Arcadia Diagnostics
Attachments: MAP_v2.xlsx
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Lucas Perez <lucas.perez@arcadiadiagnostics.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Scaling request ahead of renewal — additional on‑prem cluster & isolation

Lucas — thanks for the clear ask and the MAP. We can support an Atlanta on‑prem cluster and the isolation carve‑out; below are the practical next steps I suggest so we can get you priced and scheduled before your Feb renewal: 

1) Mutual action plan (MAP) update — we'll propose two paths: a) 24‑month term + reserved on‑prem cluster (preferred for unit economics), b) 12‑month term + canary isolated cluster with staged full carve.
2) Operational scope — Marissa will propose a cutover runbook and target windows; we'll need network contacts for VPN/IP AMI allowlist details.
3) Commercials — Kimberly, can you confirm discount schedule and any renewal credit for early commitment?

I can host a 30m slot Thurs 11am PT — works? If you prefer earlier, we can do Wed afternoon. I'll attach a draft SOW exhibit for the isolation work (SOW-exhibitB-draft.pdf) once Kimberly and Marissa confirm pricing/ops.

— Evelyn Hart
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Scaling request ahead of renewal — additional on‑prem cluster & isolation

Team — quick note on commercial posture:

- For a 24‑month commitment (reserved on‑prem cluster) we can offer a 12% unit discount on dedicated nodes + waive the standard onboarding fee (one‑time).
- For a 12‑month commitment with staged carve we can offer 6% discount and a one‑time credit equivalent to 25% of a single month of the new cluster as an onboarding credit if they sign before Jan 15.
- We should hold deal id D-78512 and request PO template from procurement contact.

Evelyn — include a line item for an isolation engineering block (X days) in the SOW; Marissa to confirm how many days operationally. Also confirm whether Arcadia requires SOC2 attestation addendum in the contract.

-Kimberly
Head of Sales, Enterprise
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lucas Perez <lucas.perez@arcadiadiagnostics.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 10:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Scaling request ahead of renewal — additional on‑prem cluster & isolation

Lucas — operational outline below and what we need from you to hit a Feb cut: 

Operational proposal (high level):
- Pre‑work (2 weeks): confirm hardware rack space & network handoff, provide IP ranges and service account for Redwood deploys.
- Provisioning (2–3 weeks): image/config push, KV cache priming, model artifacts sync.
- Isolation validation (1 week): access controls, test harness for PHI ingress, audit log verification.
- Cutover/Canary (1 week): mirror traffic to new cluster, staged routing switch.

Target: 6–8 weeks from approved SOW and signed PO. If you sign an early renewal commitment with the 24‑month path, we can prioritize ordering and potentially shorten provisioning to 5 weeks (expedite option).

Attachments: SOW‑exhibitB‑draft.pdf (exhibits scope & runbook). I've linked a runbook draft here: https://redwood.box.com/s/abc123example

Please confirm: 1) preferred term (12 vs 24), 2) target cutover weekend (we recommend Sat night to Sun morning), 3) primary network contact (name + email). Once confirmed, I'll lock dates and send the runbook & cutover checklist.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lucas Perez <lucas.perez@arcadiadiagnostics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 15:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Scaling request ahead of renewal — additional on‑prem cluster & isolation

Lucas — quick technical checklist and caveats to consider: 

Network & infra prerequisites:
- VPN tunnel + BGP or IPSec required for control plane connectivity.
- Allowlist these outbound endpoints: 34.201.12.45/32, 54.211.66.10/32 (example deploy IPs) — we'll provide final list in SOW.
- Dedicated storage affinity recommended for PHI workloads; we'll configure separate LUNs and encryption keys.

Performance notes:
- If you expect burst > 2x current MAP peak, request we add an autoscale buffer (+20%) to the cluster spec to avoid throttling during onboarding.
- Model artifact sync may take 12–24 hours for large transformer packages depending on WAN throughput. We can pre‑seed artifacts if you provide an internal mirror.

If Arcadia needs <4 weeks lead time, we should consider a temporary Dedicated-hosted fallback for the canary while on‑prem work completes. Happy to draft the network appendix for the SOW.

— Karthik
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
From: Lucas Perez <lucas.perez@arcadiadiagnostics.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <purchasing@arcadiadiagnostics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Dec 2026 09:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Scaling request ahead of renewal — additional on‑prem cluster & isolation

Evelyn — thanks and confirmed. We want to proceed with the 24‑month term and the reserved on‑prem cluster (priority lane + isolation). Confirming the network contact: Anita Rao (anita.rao@arcadiadiagnostics.com).

We accept Kimberly's commercial posture (12% discount + waive onboarding fee) subject to SOW + PO. Please:
- Send final SOW with the isolation exhibit and runbook.
- I'll have procurement issue a PO by Dec 20 if SOW matches.

On the cutover weekend — prefer Sat night (02:00 UTC) — Marissa, please hold that window tentatively.

Thanks,
Lucas
